newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint firms vs dlr, BCE grain futures in focus.
newsitem.headline: Forint firms vs dlr, BCE grain futures in focus.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed firmer against the dollar on Wednesday as third quarter U.S. GDP data gave little support to U.S. currency, dealers said.
"The dollar was seemingly unaffected by GDP figures just released," said Gabor Liener of Unicbank.
The forint closed at 155.03 against the U.S. unit compared with the opening of 155.37/42 and firmly on the central bank bid after a quiet day's trade, dealers added.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) the grain section stole the show leaving the currency futures section in shadow.
"There was considerable clearing activity in the grain section and dealers focused on that," said Peter Janoska of the BCE.
BCE currency futures turnover totalled a meagre 455 million forints sharply dropping from 9.81 billion on Tuesday.
The Japanese yen, which dropped for five maturities, attracted more than two-thirds of the total 2,884 contracts.
